entries.title: Psalms 107:1
segments: O give thanks unto Jehovah; For he is good; For his lovingkindness [endureth] for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 107:2
segments: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say [so], Whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

entries.title: Psalms 107:3
segments: And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and  from the south.

entries.title: Psalms 107:4
segments: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.

entries.title: Psalms 107:5
segments: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.

entries.title: Psalms 107:6
segments: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he delivered them out of their distresses,

entries.title: Psalms 107:7
segments: He led them also by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.

entries.title: Psalms 107:8
segments: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:9
segments: For he satisfieth the longing soul, And the hungry soul he filleth with good.

entries.title: Psalms 107:10
segments: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron,

entries.title: Psalms 107:11
segments: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High:

entries.title: Psalms 107:12
segments: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor; They fell down, and there was none to help.

entries.title: Psalms 107:13
segments: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saved them out of their distresses.

entries.title: Psalms 107:14
segments: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And brake their bonds in sunder.

entries.title: Psalms 107:15
segments: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:16
segments: For he hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.

entries.title: Psalms 107:17
segments: Fools because of  their transgression, And because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

entries.title: Psalms 107:18
segments: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food; And they draw near unto the gates of death.

entries.title: Psalms 107:19
segments: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saveth them out of their distresses.

entries.title: Psalms 107:20
segments: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, And delivereth [them] from their  destructions.

entries.title: Psalms 107:21
segments: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:22
segments: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare his works with singing.

entries.title: Psalms 107:23
segments: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters;

entries.title: Psalms 107:24
segments: These see the works of Jehovah, And his wonders in the deep.

entries.title: Psalms 107:25
segments: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, Which lifteth up the waves thereof.

entries.title: Psalms 107:26
segments: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again to the depths: Their soul melteth away because of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 107:27
segments: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And  are at their wits' end.

entries.title: Psalms 107:28
segments: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he bringeth them out of their distresses.

entries.title: Psalms 107:29
segments: He maketh the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof are still.

entries.title: Psalms 107:30
segments: Then are they glad because they are quiet; So he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

entries.title: Psalms 107:31
segments: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

entries.title: Psalms 107:32
segments: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, And praise him in the seat of the elders.

entries.title: Psalms 107:33
segments: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;

entries.title: Psalms 107:34
segments: A fruitful land into a salt desert, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

entries.title: Psalms 107:35
segments: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.

entries.title: Psalms 107:36
segments: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, That they may prepare a city of habitation,

entries.title: Psalms 107:37
segments: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, And get them fruits of increase.

entries.title: Psalms 107:38
segments: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; And he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

entries.title: Psalms 107:39
segments: Again, they are diminished and bowed down Through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

entries.title: Psalms 107:40
segments: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.

entries.title: Psalms 107:41
segments: Yet setteth he the needy on high from affliction, And maketh [him] families like a flock.

entries.title: Psalms 107:42
segments: The upright shall see it, and be glad; And all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 107:43
segments: Whoso is wise will give heed to these things; And they will consider the lovingkindnesses of Jehovah.
